title: What is Nexora?
body: Nexora is a B2B SaaS company focused on digital operations and process automation. It provides a cloud-based platform that helps organizations automate internal workflows such as HR, compliance, and procurement.

title: What industry is Nexora in?
body: Nexora operates in the B2B SaaS industry, specializing in digital operations and process automation.

title: What does Nexora do?
body: Nexora provides a cloud platform that helps organizations standardize and automate internal workflows across functions such as HR, compliance, and procurement.

title: What kind of product does Nexora offer?
body: Nexora offers a cloud-based workflow automation platform designed to streamline internal operations, reduce manual work, and improve process consistency.

title: Which workflows can Nexora automate?
body: Nexora supports automation of internal workflows including HR processes, compliance workflows, and procurement-related processes.

title: Is Nexora a cloud platform?
body: Yes. Nexora's product is a cloud-based platform that automates and manages internal workflows such as HR, compliance, and procurement.

title: How many employees does Nexora have?
body: Nexora has approximately 320 employees.

title: How large is Nexora?
body: Nexora employs around 320 people across multiple business functions.

title: How is Nexora organized internally?
body: Nexora is organized into core functions including Product and Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, Operations and Compliance, IT and Data, and Knowledge and Enablement.

title: What does the Product and Engineering team do?
body: The Product and Engineering team is responsible for designing, building, and improving the Nexora platform.

title: What does the Sales team do?
body: The Sales team engages with prospects and customers, explains Nexora's value proposition, and supports commercial discussions.

title: What does the Customer Success team do?
body: Customer Success helps customers use Nexora effectively after onboarding and supports them in achieving value from workflow automation.

title: What does the Operations and Compliance team do?
body: Operations and Compliance focuses on operational excellence and ensuring processes align with internal standards and compliance requirements.

title: What is IT and Data responsible for?
body: IT and Data supports internal technology operations and data capabilities that enable secure and efficient operations.

title: What is the Knowledge and Enablement function?
body: Knowledge and Enablement is responsible for maintaining validated and official information to ensure consistent and accurate communication.

title: Why did Nexora create a Knowledge and Enablement function?
body: Nexora created Knowledge and Enablement to standardize information, reduce inconsistent responses, and ensure teams and customers rely on validated content.

title: Troubleshooting: Unable to log in
body: If you are unable to log in, try verifying your credentials, resetting your password, clearing your browser cache, or using an incognito window. If the issue continues, contact support with the time of the error.

title: Troubleshooting: Login timeout error
body: If login times out, check your internet connection, refresh the page, and try again after a few minutes. Switching browsers or clearing cache may help.

title: Troubleshooting: CSV export not working
body: If CSV export does not work, try reducing the date range or exporting smaller datasets. Make sure pop-ups are allowed in your browser.

title: Troubleshooting: Changes not saved
body: If changes are not saved, refresh the page and try again. Ensure you click the save button and wait for confirmation before leaving the page.

title: Troubleshooting: Slow platform performance
body: If the platform feels slow, check your internet connection, close unused browser tabs, and try again later using the latest browser version.

title: Known Issue: CSV export fails for large reports
body: Some users may experience errors when exporting very large reports to CSV. As a workaround, reduce the date range or export data in smaller parts. A permanent fix is planned.

title: Known Issue: Delayed email notifications
body: Email notifications may be delayed during peak usage periods. Messages are not lost and will be delivered once the delay is resolved.

title: Known Issue: Session timeout after inactivity
body: Sessions may time out after a period of inactivity for security reasons. Please save your work regularly and log in again if this occurs.

title: Known Issue: Dashboard data refresh delay
body: Dashboard data may not update in real time and can be delayed by a few minutes. Refreshing the page usually resolves the issue.
